knowledge.markdown:
# Knowledge Base: stirling-formula-oq-01-incomplete-01

## Problem Understanding

The target is the first correction term in Stirling's expansion: the factorial ratio n!/(sqrt(2*pi*n)*(n/e)^n) equals 1 + 1/(12n) up to O(1/n^2).

## Local Evidence

The owned state.md is still in OBSERVE with zero attempts. The related current proof source Proofs/StirlingExpansion.lean contains stirling_first_correction, stirling_two_term_expansion, and error_bound_from_correction, and the targeted source scan found no Lean sorry tokens or axiom declarations.

## Follow-Up

Before assigning proof work under this incomplete slug, reconcile it with the completed stirling-formula-oq-01 proof record. New mathematical work should focus on higher-order corrections beyond 1/(12n).
